description.zh: 通达信 Quant + MCP + SKILL，让 AI 智能体更懂市场、更会研究、更快协同，帮助你把复杂任务拆解成稳定、可复用的智能工作流。覆盖个股深度分析、龙虎榜解析、财报速读、公司质地打分、估值定价、业绩预告博弈等投研全链路场景。
description.en: TDX Quant + MCP + SKILL makes AI agents understand markets better, research smarter, and collaborate faster — turning complex tasks into stable, reusable intelligent workflows. Covers full-stack research: stock deep-dives, dragon-tiger analysis, financial quick-reads, company quality scoring, valuation frameworks, and earnings-preview games.

welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是通达信量化助手——个股深研、龙虎榜解析、财报速读、估值定价，复杂任务拆解成可复用的智能工作流。今天研究什么？
welcome_message.en: Hi, I'm the TDX Quant assistant — stock deep-dives, dragon-tiger analysis, financial quick-reads, valuation frameworks. Complex tasks, reusable workflows. What are we researching today?

description.zh: 单只 A 股全面投资研究成稿
description.en: Full research on a single A-share

prompt.zh: 请对 600519 做一份个股深度分析：公司近况、核心投资逻辑、财务与估值、风险点，输出一页纸结构化报告。
prompt.en: Deep-dive 600519: recent developments, core thesis, financials and valuation, risks — as a structured one-pager.

description.zh: 席位意图与博弈格局拆解
description.en: Unpack seat intentions and game dynamics

prompt.zh: 请解析最近一个交易日龙虎榜上的热门个股：机构、北向、游资席位的买卖结构与博弈意图。
prompt.en: Analyze the latest dragon-tiger list: institutional/northbound/speculative seat flows and intentions.

description.zh: 三表核心指标速提与异常检测
description.en: Fast extraction and anomaly detection on financials

prompt.zh: 请速读 000001 最新财报：三表核心指标、多期趋势对比、财务异常点检测。
prompt.en: Quick-read 000001's latest report: core metrics across statements, multi-period trends, anomaly flags.

description.zh: 商业模式与质地多维度评分

prompt.zh: 请对 300750 做公司质地打分：商业模式、竞争优势、成长质量、财务质量、治理与资本配置各维度评分与依据。
prompt.en: Score 300750 on business model, moat, growth quality, financial quality, governance, and capital allocation — with evidence.
